criteria.criterion: Attempt in-repository code search for the Depends definition in fastapi/fastapi
criteria.final_justification: The agent did make a clear attempt to use GitHub code search (query is appropriate and scoped to the repo). Even though results/blocker are not visually confirmed, the attempt itself is evidenced by the typed query and the action history submission. Keep full credit for attempting in-repo search.

criteria.criterion: Identify the true definition location vs. a re-export/import (as supported by in-repo evidence)
criteria.final_justification: This criterion requires identifying the true definition location vs re-export/import with in-repo evidence. The agent provided neither (and the claimed sign-in blocker is not evidenced). This is a substantive miss, not an uncontrollable blocker confirmed by screenshots.

criteria.criterion: Report file path and line number for the defining declaration when available
criteria.final_justification: The requested deliverable (exact file path + line number) is not provided. Because the alleged blocker is not visually substantiated, this cannot be treated as an uncontrollable blocker for scoring; it is simply incomplete.

criteria.criterion: Provide definition context (declaration header / surrounding symbol) as confirmation
criteria.final_justification: No definition context or confirming declaration was recorded in the output, and none is visible. Without verified blocker evidence, this is a direct failure to supply the required confirmation context.

criteria.criterion: Stop after recording the requested search result details
criteria.final_justification: The stopping condition is to stop after recording search result + path + line + context. The agent stopped, but before recording any of those required details. This criterion should be penalized accordingly.

criteria.criterion: Respect constraints (no sign-in, no file edits, no pull request)
criteria.final_justification: All constraints were respected: no sign-in, no edits, no PR.
